content: Reusable game rule values, labels, status names, timing thresholds, and defaults belong in src/core/constants.js first, then every caller should use the shared constant instead of copying magic numbers or status strings.

Daily simulation behavior is orchestrated through src/systems/daily-pipeline.js. The daily pipeline sequences employee outcomes, work items, portfolio, customers/manufacturing, finance, market/labor, valuation, investor reaction, board review, workforce, executive communication, operating health, metrics, narrative, crisis/loss, and validation.
Windows releases are built with npm run test:package-windows and copied to dist/windows with a portable EXE, installer, manifest, and SHA256SUMS.

Work AI and Institutional Learning own work choices and outcomes. Social Personality AI owns familiarity, relationships, reputation, culture traces, and conversations, but may only recommend bounded stress and morale changes through the emotional system.

CEO messages and memos live primarily in src/systems/executive-messages.js. They generate structured communications, evidence, sender credibility, department viewpoints, three-choice CEO decisions, archives, read/deleted state, follow-ups, and recommendation scoring.

Office Aquarium is an offline browser/Tauri organization simulation. Office_Aquarium.html is the launch shell; core rules live in src/core, reusable services in src/services, gameplay systems in src/systems, rendering and validation UI in src/ui, OOP facades in src/facades, and startup bindings in src/bootstrap.
Office_Aquarium.html is the main launch file; simulation code is organized under src/core, src/services, src/systems, src/ui, src/facades, and src/bootstrap.

Project behavior lives in src/systems/project-portfolio.js. Projects have hidden reality, visible estimates, required departments/headcount, assigned employees, work items, milestones, backlog/blocker state, commercial potential, archive behavior, and learning-gated execution modifiers.
Itch.io web releases are built with npm run test:package-web. The package inlines CSS, JavaScript, and audio into dist/itch-web/index.html and validates zero browser errors and failed requests.

Canonical recruitable roles and their rooms, departments, skills, capabilities, salaries, and recruiting difficulty live in src/core/role-definitions.js. The founding team is eight roles: Software Engineer, Firmware Engineer, Hardware Engineer, Chip Architect, Software QA Engineer, Industrial Designer, Product Manager, and Finance Analyst.
The project has many targeted npm tests plus npm test for full validation. Use targeted tests around changed systems before running broad checks.

Use targeted npm scripts around changed systems and npm test for full validation. Web packaging is npm run test:package-web; Windows packaging is npm run test:package-windows; release metadata verification is npm run verify:release-metadata.

Workforce, recruiting, onboarding, leadership scale, capability coverage, staffing pressure, PIPs, hiring requests, promotions, retention, and hiring integrity repair live primarily in src/systems/workforce-leadership.js.
